lines: 深夜。
夜寒凝重，冷风呜咽。
密布的阴云遮蔽了月光，掩着下方本就错综复杂的街巷更加幽暗阴沉。
一道黑影狼狈的贴着墙根疾奔，粗重的喘息拉扯着肺腑，带来一阵阵刺痛，可他却不敢有丝毫停顿。
因为在他的身后，还有一道轻盈灵动的身影正紧追不舍。
少女提剑逐来，金眸淡漠，纤细的剑身上亮起灼热金纹，随着少女步伐跃动，在夜色中拖拽出一条绚丽的光尾，十分醒目。
追杀的目的也很简单，前面逃窜的人位列通缉榜第九十七位，合欢宗，陈大鹏。
为了修行，他祸害了开阳国内不少贞洁女子，窃取其元阴，引起民愤，令人众怒难忍，即使修为还差一线，也算是凭本事上榜了。
从名字上也能看出，他在某方面惊人的造诣。
而能够持续为祸一方，除了那方面，最为重要的当然是跑路能力！
可这次，他遇到了个狠茬子。
天墟弟子，乐（yue）临清。
她擅使一把金纹长剑，功参至阳，修为年纪轻轻竟已达到灵觉圆满。
正面一交手，陈大鹏被砍得差点丧命。
哪怕眼下逃窜，修为的差距也导致他始终甩不脱乐临清。
要不是在街巷中怕伤及无辜，乐临清手段因此受限，恐怕他早就寄了。
“妈了个巴子，这娘们怎么这么难缠！”
陈大鹏回头，眼见乐临清越追越近，心中不免焦急起来。
直到在远处，走投无路的他瞥见了一间屋宇窗户大开，一个用了和死了差不多的计策艰难浮上心头。
有一招大概率能够脱身，但却需要动用合欢宗内令人谈之变色的禁术——「阴阳倒转」！
这是宗内一门极其强大的神通，据传原本有改天换地，旋转乾坤之能！
只可惜传承至今，早已面目全非……沦为了施展之后，可颠倒自身阴阳的诡异法门。
至于代价，则是陈大鹏不能保证在使用后，自己还能从「朋」重新变回「鹏」！
可比起真的身死道消，陈大鹏咬碎了牙，决定赌这一把！
打定主意后，他立刻将身上剩余的各种暗器投掷而出。
其中有各种暗器、烟弹毒丹，以及他精心准备的热血沸腾药，一股脑都被陈大鹏扔了出去。
望着掷来繁杂，不知深浅的暗器，乐临清剑势一缓，不得不谨慎应对。
趁此良机，陈大鹏一个加速，便纵身跃入了窗户之中。
屋内一片漆黑，陈大鹏目光四下扫视，手上悄然翻出了一张树皮面具。
这是一件特殊的法宝，除了可以改变佩戴者的容貌、身材、衣物、气息外，还能控制佩戴者的言行举止！
再配合着性别颠倒，只需将面具扣在他人脸上，将其伪装成‘陈大鹏’，让乐临清抓去，自己便能安然脱身！
陈大鹏虚扣着面具，正寻找倒霉蛋，目光看向床榻时——
他的眼角余光里，一个模糊的影子竟凭空闯了进来，仿佛从黑暗中生长出来一般。
陈大鹏心头猛地一惊，心脏像被人用力攥了把，气血奔涌，双眼都差点瞪出来。
本来被追杀就心神紧绷，这突兀来一下，好悬差点给他当场送走。
他着慌地扭过头，这才看清了身影的面容。
是个少年，模样俊俏的让他有些嫉妒，身上则穿着奇异的未曾见过的服饰，最为重要的是，这人身上没有丝毫灵力！
陈大鹏不清楚是少年没睡，自己过于慌乱没看到，还是少年突然出现在自己面前，但在察觉到少年只是个凡人时，恐惧已然转化为了愤怒！
而刚‘穿越’来的许平秋也是一脸茫然。
他记得自己明明躺在床上，刚一安详的闭上眼，就莫名出现在了这里。
content_en:
late at night.
The night is cold and the wind is whining.
Dense clouds blocked the moonlight, making the already intricate streets below even darker and gloomier.
"Huh-huh-"
A black shadow ran awkwardly against the wall, and his heavy breathing stretched his lungs, causing waves of stinging pain, but he did not dare to stop at all.
Because behind him, there was a light and agile figure chasing after him.
The girl came towards him with her sword in hand, her golden eyes indifferent, and the slender sword body lit up with scorching golden patterns. As the girl jumped in her steps, it dragged out a gorgeous light tail in the night, which was very eye-catching.
The purpose of the pursuit is also very simple. The person who fled in front is ranked 97th on the wanted list, Hehuan Sect, Chen Dapeng.
In order to practice cultivation, he harmed many chaste women in Kaiyang and stole their Yuan Yin, which aroused public anger and made everyone unbearable. Even if his cultivation level is still a little short of a sliver, he is still on the list based on his ability.
It can also be seen from the name that he has amazing attainments in certain aspects.
As for being able to continue to cause trouble, apart from that aspect, the most important thing is of course the ability to escape!
But this time, he encountered a tough problem.
A disciple of Tianxu, Yue Linqing.
She is good at wielding a long sword with golden patterns, and her skill reaches the highest level of Yang. She has reached spiritual perfection at a young age.
In a head-on confrontation, Chen Dapeng was almost killed.
Even if he was running away now, the gap in cultivation meant that he could never escape Le Linqing.
If it weren't for the fear of hurting innocent people in the streets, Le Linqing's means were therefore limited, I'm afraid he would have sent it long ago.
"What the fuck, why are these bitches so difficult to deal with!"
Chen Dapeng turned around and saw Le Linqing getting closer and closer, and couldn't help but feel anxious.
Until in the distance, when he was desperate, he caught a glimpse of a house with its windows wide open, and a plan that was almost dead came to his mind.
There is a trick that has a high probability of escaping, but it requires the use of the infamous forbidden technique within the Hehuan Sect - "Yin-Yang Reversal"!
This is an extremely powerful magical power in the sect. It is said that it can change the world and change the world!
It's a pity that the inheritance has been changed beyond recognition... and it has become a strange method that can reverse one's yin and yang after being used.
As for the price, Chen Dapeng cannot guarantee that after using it, he can change from "Peng" back to "Peng" again!
But compared to the real death, Chen Dapeng gritted his teeth and decided to take a gamble!
After making up his mind, he immediately threw out the remaining hidden weapons on his body.
Among them were various hidden weapons, smoke bombs, poisonous elixirs, and the blood boiling medicine he carefully prepared, all of which were thrown out by Chen Dapeng.
Looking at the complicated and unknown hidden weapons thrown at him, Le Linqing's sword power slowed down and he had to deal with it cautiously.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Chen Dapeng accelerated and jumped into the window.
The room was dark. Chen Dapeng glanced around and quietly pulled out a bark mask in his hand.
This is a special magic weapon. In addition to changing the wearer's appearance, body shape, clothing, and breath, it can also control the wearer's words and deeds!
Coupled with the gender reversal, you only need to put the mask on other people's faces, disguise them as 'Chen Dapeng', let Le Linqing catch them, and you can escape safely!
Chen Dapeng was wearing his mask and was looking for the unlucky guy. When he looked at the bed——
In the corner of his eye, a vague shadow broke in out of thin air, as if growing out of the darkness.
Chen Dapeng was suddenly startled, his heart seemed to be squeezed hard, blood surged, and his eyes almost popped out.
He was already nervous when he was being chased, but this sudden incident almost made him send away on the spot.
He turned his head in panic, and then he saw the figure's face clearly.
He was a young man. He was so handsome that he was a little jealous. He was wearing strange clothes that he had never seen before. The most important thing was that this man had no spiritual power at all!
Chen Dapeng didn't know whether the boy was awake, he was too panicked and didn't see it, or the boy suddenly appeared in front of him, but when he realized that the boy was just a mortal, his fear had turned into anger!
And Xu Pingqiu, who had just 'travelled', also looked confused.
He remembered that he was clearly lying on the bed, and as soon as he closed his eyes peacefully, he appeared here inexplicably.
